purpose: Existing kitchen and salon construction cameras retained unchanged; current combined-scene framing requires render review. Original photographs remain uncropped evidence.

views.note: Reverse view checks cabinet face, sink depth, room portal and stool grouping; flowers disabled for geometry comparison.
views.fit_note: Five manually annotated stone/sink points; all coplanar inferred geometry. Native24mm fixed. Pose and shift remain ambiguous; use reverse view to check construction, not surveyed dimensions. Solution touches the y=9.1m lower bound; this indicates residual ambiguity. No room geometry was changed to reduce this residual.

views.point_coordinates: u right, v down; normalized to complete uncropped original image

reference_capture.sensor_source: Full-frame 36mm convention; native EXIF focal length retained.
reference_capture.crop_and_shift: Edited JPEG: optical shift, crop, stitching and correction profiles are not retained in the extracted EXIF tags. Metadata identifies physical optics, not a uniquely recoverable final image field.

views.effective_focal_source: Native EXIF physical focal length converted to a 36mm sensor by physical long axis; no free focal fit.

fit_solver.method: scipy.optimize.least_squares, bounded default trust-region-reflective method, soft_l1 loss, f_scale=0.025, max_nfev=5000
fit_solver.initial_camera: baseline_camera and rejected_initial in this view; yaw=atan2(target_y-location_y,target_x-location_x)
fit_solver.fixed_optics: 24 mm native EXIF focal length, 36 mm sensor long axis, level camera, zero roll
fit_solver.objective: Normalized projected-minus-annotated UV residuals with square-root point weights, plus (z-z_initial)*0.01 and shift_x*0.002, shift_y*0.002 soft terms; holdout landmarks excluded.
fit_solver.limitations: Five coplanar inferred stone/sink points, no independent holdouts; solution touches the y=9.1 m lower bound. Unknown optical shift, crop and correction preserve pose/geometry ambiguity. This records the original solve, not a new fit.
